Maya Chen: 12 minutes until all-hands. Quick room check: stream up? local recorder healthy? slides final?
Lin (SRE): Recorder OK. OBS had a plugin hang earlier; restarted and disabled the plugin. Pinned fallback RTMP.
Devon - AV: Camera and mics checked. Switched Presenter mic to channel 2 to avoid clipping. Wired network confirmed.
Sanjay - Product: I updated one slide (Dedicated Optimize -> "pilot Q2") and removed a detailed bullet per Chriss note. Link to deck: https://drive/redwood/allhands/2799001111
Maya Chen: Reminder: use the stream-fallback runbook if disconnects. @recorder-bot will upload to S3 after.
Lin (SRE): Quick obs restart command in case OBS freezes:
```
sudo systemctl restart obs.service
# or: sudo pkill -9 obs && nohup /usr/bin/obs >/tmp/obs.log 2>&1 &
```
Chris - CEO: I'll keep leadership remarks to 6 mins. Planning to mention hiring priorities for infra and the Dedicated pilot.
Maya Chen: Order tweak: leadership -> infra -> customer Q&A. We moved Customer Q&A later to allow infra to run long.
Sanjay - Product: Priya will run the AMA follow-up doc, I'll add the latency vs cost FAQ to #docs after the call.
recorder-bot: Recording captured locally. Upload queued: s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/2799001111/session.mp4
Devon - AV: If local recorder fails, plug HDMI passthrough to backup recorder B and start manual capture.
Maya Chen: Final: presenters mute when not speaking, use wired ethernet, and I'll post final slide link in 5. :thumbsup:
